scenes.title: A Different Morning
scenes.body: That morning, everything felt ready for a whole day of surprises. The path ahead was full of possibilities, and it was time to begin.
scenes.altText: A sunny landscape with a path fading into the horizon

scenes.title: The New Path
scenes.body: Every step revealed something nobody had noticed before. Tiny details, new sounds, and a whole world waiting to be explored.
scenes.altText: A trail lined with colorful flowers and shiny leaves

scenes.title: An Unexpected Challenge
scenes.body: Suddenly, the path became hard. But with patience, attention, and a good idea, the answer appeared closer than anyone expected.
scenes.altText: A delicate bridge over a stream with safe stones on the bank

scenes.title: Help From Everywhere
scenes.body: Everyone pitched in a little: a friendly hand, a kind word, and a caring gesture made everything feel lighter.
scenes.altText: Several friendly characters carrying a package together along the path

scenes.title: The Happy Way Back
scenes.body: Back home, the whole day felt like a great treasure kept in memory, ready to be remembered with a smile.
scenes.altText: A golden sunset over the path leading back home
